items.source: If the supplied locations are null or empty and isGenerateDefaultLocations() returns true, default locations will be generated (i.e., detected) for the specified class and the configured resource suffixes; otherwise, the supplied locations will be modified if necessary and returned.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `locations` 为 `null` 或空，且 isGenerateDefaultLocations() 返回 `true`，则将为指定的 class 和配置的 resource suffixes generated（即检测）默认位置；否则，将对提供的 `locations` 进行必要的 修改 并返回。

items.source: context - the newly created application context
items.translation: context - 新创建的应用程序上下文

items.source: AbstractContextLoader also provides a basis for all concrete implementations of the SmartContextLoader SPI. For backwards compatibility with the ContextLoader SPI, processContextConfiguration(ContextConfigurationAttributes) delegates to processLocations(Class, String...).
items.translation: AbstractContextLoader 还为所有具体实现的SmartContextLoader SPI 提供了基础。为了与ContextLoader SPI 保持向后兼容，processContextConfiguration(ContextConfigurationAttributes)会委托给processLocations(Class, String...)。

items.source: The semantics of this method have been overloaded to include detection of either default resource locations or default configuration classes. Consequently, this method can also be used to determine whether default configuration classes should be detected if the classes present in the configuration attributes supplied to processContextConfiguration(ContextConfigurationAttributes) are null or empty.
items.translation: 此方法的语义已重载，以包含对默认资源位置或默认配置类的检测。因此，如果提供给configuration attributes中的classes为null或空，则此方法也可用于确定是否应检测default配置类。

items.source: For example, if the supplied class is com.example.MyTest, the generated locations will contain a single string with a value of "classpath:com/example/MyTest<suffix>", where <suffix> is the value of the first configured resource suffix for which the generated location actually exists in the classpath.
items.translation: 例如，如果提供的类是com.example.MyTest，生成的位置将包含一个字符串，其值为"classpath:com/example/MyTest<suffix>"，其中<suffix>是在类路径中实际存在的第一个配置的资源后缀的值。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to all context customizers that have been registered with the supplied mergedConfig.
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给所有已注册到提供的 `mergedConfig` 的context customizers。

items.source: The implementation of this method adheres to the contract defined in the SmartContextLoader SPI. Specifically, this method will preemptively verify that the generated default location actually exists. If it does not exist, this method will log a warning and return an empty array.
items.translation: 此方法的实现遵循在 SmartContextLoader SPI 中定义的契约。具体而言，此方法将 预先 验证生成的默认位置是否实际存在。如果该位置不存在，此方法将记录警告并返回空数组。

items.source: Subclasses must provide an implementation of this method that returns a single suffix. Alternatively subclasses may provide a no-op implementation of this method and override getResourceSuffixes() in order to provide multiple custom suffixes.
items.translation: 子类必须提供此方法的实现，以返回单个后缀。或者，子类可以提供此方法的空操作（no-op）实现，并覆盖getResourceSuffixes()，以便提供多个自定义后缀。

items.source: The default implementation simply delegates to TestContextResourceUtils.convertToClasspathResourcePaths(Class, String...).
items.translation: 默认实现只是委托给 TestContextResourceUtils.convertToClasspathResourcePaths(Class, String...)。

items.source: The default implementation simply wraps the value returned by getResourceSuffix() in a single-element array, but this can be overridden by subclasses in order to support multiple suffixes.
items.translation: 默认实现只是将 getResourceSuffix() 返回的值包装在单个元素的数组中，但子类可以重写它以支持多个后缀。

items.source: Subclasses can override this method to implement a different default location generation strategy.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以实施不同的默认位置生成策略。

items.source: Subclasses can override this method to implement a different location modification strategy.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以实现不同的位置修改策略。

items.source:
Can be overridden in subclasses — for example, to process
annotated classes instead of resource locations.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写——例如，用于处理注释类而非资源位置。

items.translation: 默认实现：

items.source: Can be overridden by subclasses to change the default behavior.
items.translation: 可被子类重写以更改默认行为。

items.source: The default implementation processes locations analogous to processLocations(Class, String...), using the declaring class as the test class and the resource locations retrieved from the supplied configuration attributes as the locations to process.
items.translation: 默认实现处理位置的方式类似于 processLocations(Class, String...)，使用声明类作为测试类，并使用从提供的配置属性中检索的资源位置作为要处理的位置。

items.source: Determine whether default resource locations should be generated if the locations provided to processLocations(Class, String...) are null or empty.
items.translation: 确定是否应生成default资源位置，如果提供给processLocations(Class, String...)的locations为null或为空。

items.source: Get the suffix to append to ApplicationContext resource locations when detecting default locations.
items.translation: 获取要附加到检测默认位置时的 `ApplicationContext` 资源位置的后缀。

items.source: Get the suffixes to append to ApplicationContext resource locations when detecting default locations.
items.translation: 获取在检测默认位置时要附加到 ApplicationContext 资源位置的后缀。

items.source:
Determines what (if any) context initializer classes have been supplied via the MergedContextConfiguration and instantiates and invokes each with the given application context.
  • Any ApplicationContextInitializers implementing Ordered or annotated with @Order will be sorted appropriately.
items.translation:
确定已通过 `MergedContextConfiguration` 提供（如果有）哪些上下文初始化器类，并实例化每个类，然后使用给定的应用程序上下文调用它们。
  • 任何实现Ordered或带有@Order注解的ApplicationContextInitializers都将按适当顺序排序。

items.source: Adds PropertySources for all resource locations and inlined properties from the supplied MergedContextConfiguration to the Environment of the context.
items.translation: 为上下文的 Environment 添加来自提供的 MergedContextConfiguration 的所有 PropertySources，包括 resource locations 和 inlined properties。

items.source: Sets the active bean definition profiles from the supplied MergedContextConfiguration in the Environment of the context.
items.translation: 设置上下文中环境的 Environment 的 active bean definition profiles，该环境来自提供的MergedContextConfiguration。
